questions.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It announces the final conclusion of the entire article.
It sums up the first phase before further cost analysis.
It introduces an example unrelated to the first phase.
It signals doubt about the first phase's reported results.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 后文还要分析成本，不能判为全文终结；这句话概括第一阶段而非引入无关例子；Overall本身不表示对结果存疑。

questions.skill: 区分并行规定、直接冲突与领域排除
questions.q: A national law creates a comprehensive safety-label system for medical devices. A state adds a parallel labelling rule. A court invalidates the state provision because the national law has occupied the field. Which inference is strongest?
o: Resemblance to national rules is enough to void a state rule.
National coverage can bar a state rule without a direct clash.
The state rule conflicted with a neighbouring state's law.
The court found the national safety-label law lacked authority.

exp.trans: 国家法律建立了全面的医疗器械安全标签制度。某州又增加了一项并行的标签规定。法院因为国家法律已经全面覆盖该领域而判定州规定无效。最有力的推断是：即使没有直接矛盾，州规定也可能因领域排除而不能成立。
exp.structure: creates与adds分别描述国家和州制定规则；because引出法院判决的原因。because the national law has occupied the field不是说两项规则必须逐字冲突，而是说明该领域已由国家立法全面规制。
exp.other: comprehensive 全面的；labelling 标签规定；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除与之不相容的州层面规制。
exp.meaning: parallel只表示并行或相应，并不自动等于contradict。判断权限问题时，要区分直接冲突与国家立法已占据整个领域这两种理由。
exp.rest: 类似不自动等于无效，关键是国家立法已全面覆盖该领域；判决没有依据邻州法律；法院承认国家规范的权威，并未否定它。

questions.skill: 作者立场 + do so 回指
questions.q: A transport ministry says that because it does not want to carry out Parliament's rail-safety plan, local councils should not be allowed to enforce it either. The court rejects this claim. What is best supported?
o: The court checks an executive attempt to extend power over local councils.
Parliament alone must enforce every rail-safety rule across all regions.
The ministry has unlimited control over local councils and their rules.
Local councils may ignore national rail-safety laws whenever they choose to do so.

exp.trans: 法院正在制衡行政部门试图扩大自身对地方议会的权力。
exp.structure: because引出交通部不愿执行议会计划的原因；should not be allowed...either表示它还想阻止地方执行；The court rejects this claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: carry out 执行；executive 行政部门；council 地方议会；reject a claim 驳回一种主张。
exp.meaning: 行政部门不愿执行议会的计划，不等于它可以阻止地方在法律允许范围内执行。法院驳回这种主张，体现对行政权的制衡。
exp.rest: 原文没有说所有铁路安全规则只能由议会执行；交通部并没有无限控制权；法院驳回行政部门的主张也不意味着地方可以无视所有国家法律。

questions.skill: 区分报告数量变化与真实问题变化
questions.q: A clinic switched to an online incident form, after which recorded reports rose. External audits found no increase in underlying faults. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The underlying fault rate rose because the clinic changed its form.
More recorded incidents may reflect easier reporting, not more faults.
External audits proved the old reporting system had been accurate.
The clinic changed the form after a separate review found fewer faults.

exp.trans: 诊所改用在线事件表单后，记录的报告增加了，但外部审计没有发现实际故障增加。记录数量的上升可能来自报告更容易，而不是故障变多。
exp.structure: A clinic switched...描述制度变化；after which引出其后的记录变化；External audits found...提供独立证据，限制对真实故障率的推断。
exp.other: incident form 事件报告表；recorded report 记录的报告；external audit 外部审计；underlying fault 实际故障。
exp.meaning: 观测到的报告数会受到报告渠道影响。记录数增加不能单独证明实际问题变多。
exp.rest: 表单变化本身不能证明故障率上升；审计没有证明旧系统完全准确；文中没有说改表单之前另一次审查发现故障减少。

questions.skill: 识别with复合结构的伴随状态
questions.q: The archive reopened at noon, with several boxes waiting in the loading area. What does the with-clause do?
o: It describes a state accompanying the archive's reopening.
It gives the sole reason the archive reopened at noon.
It reports an action that archive staff carried out.
It is the direct object of reopened in the main clause.

exp.trans: 档案馆中午重新开放，当时有几个箱子正等在装卸区。with结构补充了重新开放时伴随的状态。
exp.structure: 主干是The archive reopened at noon；with several boxes waiting in the loading area是with + 名词 + 现在分词结构，several boxes是waiting的逻辑主语。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；reopen 重新开放；loading area 装卸区；accompany 伴随。
exp.meaning: with复合结构常补充主句发生时的伴随状态。它不是reopened的直接宾语，也不自动表达原因或目的。
exp.rest: 句子没有说明这是档案馆重新开放的唯一原因；with短语描述箱子所处的状态，并未说工作人员另做了一项动作；reopened在这里是不及物动词，不需要直接宾语。

questions.target: ever vs even / 曾经与甚至
questions.q: Have you ______ attended a blind-review workshop? Surprisingly, the university ______ invited first-year students to participate. Choose the best pair.
o: even / ever
then / even
ever / even
ever / then

exp.trans: 你曾经参加过匿名评审工作坊吗？令人意外的是，学校甚至邀请大一学生参与。
exp.structure: Have you ... attended是现在完成时疑问句；ever修饰attended；Surprisingly在后句提供意外语气，even修饰invited强调连大一学生也被邀请。
exp.other: blind review 匿名评审；workshop 工作坊；first-year student 大一学生；participate 参与。
exp.meaning: ever表示曾经/在任何时候，与现在完成时常见；even表示甚至/连……也，强调程度或意外，两者不可互换。
exp.rest: 把even放在曾经参加的时间提问位置、把ever放在甚至邀请的位置，均改变原意；then只表示随后，不能表达意外程度。

questions.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
questions.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

questions.skill: 区分法官认可的结论与国会提供的理由
questions.q: A court permits county officers to check residency status during limited enforcement encounters. It cites Congress's support for joint national-local enforcement. What did the judges agree on?
o: Congress must personally direct every local enforcement decision.
Local authorities may assist with enforcement within the limits set by law.
National officers must withhold all enforcement information from local teams.
Local authorities can disregard national rules when enforcing local policy.

exp.trans: 法院允许县级执法人员在有限的执法接触中核查居住身份，并引用国会支持国家与地方共同执法的立场。法官达成一致的是：地方当局可以在法律规定的范围内协助执法。
exp.structure: A court permits...直接陈述司法结论；It cites...引出支持这一结论的立法背景。题目问What did the judges agree on，因此应回答法院允许什么，而不是重复国会的理由。
exp.other: permit 允许；residency status 居住身份；joint 共同的；enforcement 执法；withhold information 不提供信息。
exp.meaning: 阅读题要区分结论和论据。国会鼓励共同执法，是法院认可地方执法角色的理由，不是题目所问的结论本身。
exp.rest: 国会亲自指挥每项地方执法决定过于绝对；原文鼓励信息共享而非要求扣留信息；地方参与执法并不意味着可以无视国家规则。

summary-location.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
summary-location.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

summary-location.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
summary-location.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: parallel rule / occupied the field / field pre-emption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A national safety code covers the whole field of product labelling. A state adds a parallel rule, and a court invalidates it because the code has “occupied the field.” Which explanation best fits the ruling?
o: The rule failed because another state's policy directly contradicted it.
The rule was pre-empted because national law already covered the field.
The rule was approved because parallel rules can never conflict.
The court delayed the case until lawmakers revised the enforcement budget.

exp.trans: 国家安全规范全面覆盖了产品标签领域。某州又增加了一项并行规定，法院因为国家规范已经“占据了该领域”而判定州规定无效。最合适的解释是：国家法律已全面规制该领域，因此州规定被排除。
exp.structure: A national safety code covers the whole field；第二句由and连接州增加规定与法院判定无效的动作；because从句给出判决理由。occupied the field是法律语境中的领域排除概念。
exp.other: product labelling 产品标签；invalidate 判定无效；pre-empt 排除州层面的规制；enforcement budget 执法预算。
exp.meaning: parallel表示并行，不等于contradict。即使没有逐条直接冲突，若国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域，州规定仍可能被排除。
exp.rest: 另一州的政策不是本案依据；parallel rules can never conflict把并行绝对化；法院已经作出无效判决，并非等待预算调整。

text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 区分并行规则、直接冲突与领域排除
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A federal air-safety code exclusively regulates emergency signals. A city adopted a similar signal rule. Although the city's rule was not shown to contradict a specific clause, a court set it aside because the code already covered the entire field. Why?
o: The city rule was barred because national law already occupied the field.
The federal code was cancelled because the city's provisions ran parallel.
The court ordered the city to enforce its rule beside the national code.
The judges delayed a decision until the national agency reviewed its budget.

exp.trans: 一套联邦航空安全规范对紧急信号作了专属规定。某市采用了类似规则。尽管没有证明市级规则直接违反特定条文，法院仍因联邦规范已全面覆盖该领域而排除了市级规定。
exp.structure: Although引导让步：没有证明逐条直接矛盾；主句a court set it aside给出判决；because说明真正理由是整个领域已由上级规则全面规制。
exp.other: exclusively 专属地；signal 信号；contradict 与……相矛盾；set aside 废除、排除；occupy the field 通过全面规制排除下级立法。
exp.meaning: 并行或类似不等于相抵触；领域排除的判断依据是整个领域已由上级法律覆盖，不要求指出某条具体文字直接冲突。
exp.rest: 没有推翻联邦规范；法院没有命令城市同时执行两套规则；也没有推迟判决等待预算审查。

text4-federal-state-boundary.target: knock out / contested provisions / field preemption
text4-federal-state-boundary.skill: 法律词组放回语境 + 联邦与州权限边界
text4-federal-state-boundary.q: A legal report says the court 'knocked out' three contested provisions in a state's licensing plan. The judgment adds that the national legislature had already 'occupied the field,' although the state rules did not directly contradict one specific national clause. Which paraphrase best captures the reasoning?
o: The court delayed the dispute because the rules were too complicated.
The court struck down the rules because national law covered this field.
The court approved the rules as harmless additions to national policy.
The court found that the state had contradicted two other states' own laws.

exp.trans: 法院推翻了州计划中的争议条款，因为国家立法已经全面覆盖该领域。
exp.structure: knocked out表示推翻；contested provisions是有争议的条款；although引导让步，说明即使没有直接违反某一条具体规定，也可能因为occupied the field而被排除。
exp.other: knock out 推翻、使无效；contested 有争议的；provision 法律条款；occupy the field 全面覆盖某一立法领域。
exp.meaning: 判决的理由不是其他州的政策，也不是条款太复杂，而是国家立法已经全面规制该领域。parallel不自动等于contradict。
exp.rest: 延期审理与法院已经推翻条款不符；批准条款与invalidates相反；原文没有说州政策违反了另外两个州的法律。

text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的权力主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency says it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever the rule conflicts with its enforcement priorities. What does that claim imply?
o: It claims its enforcement power outweighs regional governments' authority.
Regional governments may override national laws whenever they disagree.
The legislature expressly banned all regional enforcement activity.
The agency accepts regional rules despite differences in enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要原本合法的地区规则与其执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称行政机构的执法权高于地区政府的权限。
exp.structure: An executive agency says that...引出机构的主张；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: executive agency 行政机构；invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；authority 权限。
exp.meaning: 题目问what does that claim imply，应概括机构声称自己拥有多大权限，而不是把这一主张误当成作者认可的法律结论。
exp.rest: 地区政府可以随意推翻国家法律是把权力方向反过来；立法机关明文禁止所有地区执法并未在句中出现；最后一项与机构声称可使冲突规则失效相反。

text4-executive-overreach.target: executive enforcement choice vs statutory local authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 行政不执行是否能取消地方依法获授的权力
text4-executive-overreach.q: A national agency declined to inspect licensed buses, then claimed towns could not carry out inspections that a statute authorized them to do. The court rejected the claim. What principle does its decision illustrate?
o: The agency may suspend towns' lawful inspections by choosing not to act.
The court rejected an attempt to block towns from exercising powers granted by law.
The towns were newly authorized to rewrite national transport standards.
The court found that national agencies alone may set all inspection dates.

exp.trans: 国家行政机构不愿检查已获许可的公交车，随后却声称法律已授权的市镇检查也不能执行。法院驳回该主张，说明行政机关自身选择不执法，不能自动取消地方依法获授的权限。
exp.structure: declined... then claimed...区分行政机关自身行为与扩张主张；a statute authorized them to do修饰inspections；The court rejected the claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: agency 行政机构；statute 成文法；authorize 授权；suspend 暂停；licensed bus 已获许可的公交车辆。
exp.meaning: 行政机关不执行某项政策与禁止地方执行是两个命题。这里法院限制的是行政部门把其执行偏好扩展成否定地方合法权限的企图。
exp.rest: 行政不作为并未赋予机构暂停合法地方执法的权力；法院未授权市镇重写国家标准；设定检查日期也不是法院本次驳回的争点。

text4-executive-overreach.target: claim about enforcement power vs legal authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency claims it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever that rule conflicts with the agency's enforcement priorities. What does the agency's claim amount to?
o: Regional governments can override national laws they oppose.
Its enforcement priorities can override lawful regional rules.
The legislature prohibited regional agencies from enforcing rules.
Regional rules remain valid despite different enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要某项原本合法的地区规则与该机构的执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称，该机构的执法权高于地区政府所拥有的权限。
exp.structure: claims后面是机构主张的内容；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；outweigh 权重或重要性高于。
exp.meaning: 要区分被描述的主张与文章作者认可的结论。句子是在复述行政机构想要的权力范围，并不代表作者认为这种主张正确。
exp.rest: 地区推翻国家法律反转了主张中的权力方向；立法机关禁止地方执法没有文本依据；机构声称可使规则失效，并非承认优先事项不同时规则仍有效。

example-claim-scope.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
example-claim-scope.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
example-claim-scope.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子与论点的对应范围
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It measures a shift in members' views on conservation.
It shows why government funds were needed for the trial.
It explains how the new system reduced water consumption.
It illustrates how local groups can help launch a policy.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 没有成员前后态度的测量，不能证明观点转变；材料没有交代政府资金；也没有比较节水系统的技术效果。合作社组织志愿者和动员试用，支持的是政策启动机制。

example-claim-scope.skill: 识别反例对充分条件的限制而非扩大成全面否定
example-claim-scope.q: A consultant argues that longer opening hours are enough to widen access to museums. A writer responds with a neighbourhood museum that stayed open until 10 p.m., yet attracted few additional night-shift workers. Interviews revealed that the last bus serving their workplaces left at 8 p.m. Why does the writer include this case?
o: To show that transport constraints can limit what extended hours achieve.
To identify reduced bus services as a consequence of the later museum hours.
To compare tourists' reasons for visiting with those of local residents.
To present later opening as a substitute for improving transport links.

exp.trans: 顾问认为，只要延长开放时间，就足以让更多人有机会参观博物馆。作者回应说，一家社区博物馆开放到晚上十点，却几乎没有多吸引夜班工人。访谈发现，途经他们工作地点的末班公交在晚上八点就开走了。作者为何举这个例子？为了说明交通限制会影响延长开放时间的实际效果。
exp.structure: A consultant + argues + that从句提出待检验的充分条件；A writer + responds with + a museum引出反例。that stayed open...为修饰museum的定语从句；yet转向预期未实现的结果；Interviews + revealed + that从句提供限制条件。
exp.other: widen access 扩大参与机会；neighbourhood 社区；night-shift worker 夜班工人；extended hours 延长的开放时间；transport link 交通连接。
exp.meaning: 例子针对的是延长开放时间是否单独就足够。公交仍是障碍，说明措施的效果受另一条件限制；没有证明延时开放普遍无效，也没有比较不同群体的喜好。
exp.rest: 末班车时间是已有约束，文中没有说公交服务因博物馆延时而削减；游客与本地居民的参观动机没有被比较；例子指出仅延时仍不足，不能反说延时可以替代交通改善。

example-claim-scope.skill: 把实例放回可见记录与实际行为的区分
example-claim-scope.q: An essay distinguishes a visible change in records from a change in underlying behaviour. It describes a factory where reported near-misses increased after a safety bonus was introduced. An anonymous survey found no change in how often hazards occurred; workers said they had previously kept quiet about them. What does the case illustrate?
o: The bonus increased hazards along with reports of near-misses.
Official incident totals are more reliable than the survey.
Anonymity motivated workers more than the safety bonus did.
Reporting changes can raise counts without raising hazards.

exp.trans: 文章区分记录上的可见变化与实际行为的变化。文中举例，一家工厂引入安全奖励后，上报的险情增多。匿名调查发现，危险出现的频率并没有变化；工人说自己以前对这些情况保持沉默。这个例子说明，记录数量上升可能源自上报方式改变，而不意味着危险同步增加。
exp.structure: An essay + distinguishes + A from B提出上层区分；It + describes + a factory引出例子，where从句补充上报数量变化。was introduced是被动谓语。An anonymous survey + found + no change；how often hazards occurred补充频率。had previously kept quiet指出早期漏报背景。
exp.other: near-miss 险些发生的事故、险情；underlying 实际的、深层的；anonymous 匿名的；hazard 危险因素；incident total 事件总数。
exp.meaning: 实例在支持记录变化不等于实际事件变化这一论点。新增上报与此前沉默形成对照，不能把记录增多直接推成工作更危险；也不应把例证题改答成未讨论的奖励与匿名措施孰强。
exp.rest: 调查显示危险发生频率未变，不能断言奖励增加危险；材料没有给两种数据排可靠性名次；匿名是调查方式，不能据此比较匿名与奖金的激励强度。

example-claim-scope.skill: 区分记录数量变化与真实风险变化
example-claim-scope.q: After a factory introduced anonymous reporting, recorded safety events rose. Independent inspections found no increase in hazards. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The factory became more dangerous after anonymous reporting was introduced.
The rise in reports proves workers deliberately exaggerated safety incidents.
The higher event count may reflect reporting changes rather than more hazards.
Independent inspections confirmed that hazards increased throughout the factory.

exp.trans: 工厂引入匿名报告后，记录到的安全事件增加了，但独立检查没有发现危险因素增加。最有根据的结论是：记录数量的上升可能来自报告方式的变化，而非真实危险增加。
exp.structure: After引导时间背景；recorded safety events rose描述记录数；Independent inspections found no increase in hazards提供独立证据，限制了对真实风险的推断。
exp.other: anonymous reporting 匿名报告；recorded event 记录到的事件；independent inspection 独立检查；hazard 危险因素。
exp.meaning: 报告数量是观测到的数据，可能受报告机制影响；不能直接把记录数增加等同于真实危险增加。
exp.rest: 直接断言工厂更危险，与独立检查结果不符；把报告增加归因于故意夸大，原文没有动机证据；把检查结果说反了。

with.skill: with + 名词 + 后置成分
with.q:
The bakery opened at six, with warm bread cooling on the counter.
with 后面的结构主要起什么作用？
o: 补充开门时伴随的状态
引出老板的直接引语
说明开门的唯一目的
充当opened的直接宾语

exp.trans: 面包店六点开门，当时温热的面包正在柜台上晾凉。
exp.structure: 主干：The bakery（主语）+ opened（不及物谓语）+ at six（时间状语）。原始简单句Warm bread was cooling on the counter → 去掉was，用with引出：with warm bread cooling on the counter。warm bread是with结构的逻辑主语，cooling是与之构成主动关系的现在分词。
exp.other: bakery 面包店；cool 晾凉、变凉；counter 柜台；warm 温热的。
exp.meaning: with复合结构可以补充主句发生时的伴随状态；它不是新的独立主句。
exp.rest: 直接引语通常由say等动词引出，此处没有任何说话行为。目的常用to do或in order to，原句只描写伴随状态。opened在本句是不及物用法，with短语不是其直接宾语。

with.target: with + 名词 + 后置成分
with.skill: with + 名词 + 后置修饰
with.q: The audience waited quietly, with the lights gradually dimming before the film began. The with-structure mainly:
o: adds a simultaneous background state
states the purpose of waiting
introduces an independent main clause
means the audience waited together with the lights

exp.trans: 观众安静地等待着，电影开始前，灯光正逐渐变暗。
exp.structure: 主干：The audience（主语）+ waited（谓语）+ quietly（状语）。原始简单句：The lights were gradually dimming before the film began. → 去掉were，用with引出：with the lights gradually dimming...。the lights是with结构的逻辑主语，dimming与lights构成主动关系。
exp.other: audience 观众；gradually 逐渐地；dim 变暗；before the film began 电影开始前。
exp.meaning: with + 名词 + 后置成分可补充主句发生时的伴随状态或背景。
exp.rest: 目的通常用to do/in order to；with结构不是新的独立主句；这里with不是“和灯光一起”等普通介词伴随对象，而是带逻辑主语和分词的复合结构。

cloze-time-adverbs.q: The interviewers first rated each applicant on a five-point scale. The scores were ______ combined with a written test result before the committee made its final decision.
o: ever
then
even
unless

exp.trans: 面试官先用五分制给申请者打分，随后将这些分数与笔试成绩合并，最后由委员会作出决定。
exp.structure: first标出初始步骤；The scores were then combined...是被动结构；before引出后续委员会决策，整个流程有清楚的先后顺序。
exp.other: rate 评分；scale 量表；written test 笔试；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: then表示接着/随后；ever强调在任何时候或曾经；even强调甚至/出乎意料；在中性流程描述中then最精确。
exp.rest: ever不能自然表达流程先后；even无须强调出人意料的递进；unless引导条件从句，不能直接充当这个位置的流程副词。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: Healthier seedlings prompted the gardeners to provide shade.
The gardeners' shade reduced heat exposure for the seedlings.
The seedlings sheltered the gardeners from the hottest sun.
The drying seedlings caused a fall in the surrounding heat.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: 把幼苗更健康当成遮阳的先前原因是因果倒置；幼苗保护园丁交换了施事与受益者；干枯导致环境降温既反转因果，又偷换了暴露量与环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension caused firms to miss the earlier deadline.
Measured gains in later participation prompted the council's extension.
Missed deadlines prompted an extension; later effects are unmeasured.
The earlier deadline was a response to the council's later extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: 后来的延期不能造成更早的错过期限；尚未测量的后续参与数据不能成为先前延期的依据；较早的规则也不是对较晚措施的回应。

causal-role-direction.target: causal direction / known vs unknown outcome
causal-role-direction.skill: 区分已知原因、措施与尚未验证的后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: A grant committee extended an application deadline after several applicants missed it. The report says the effect on later participation has not been measured. Which summary is justified?
o: The missed deadline prompted an extension; later participation effects remain unmeasured.
Later participation figures prompted the committee to extend the earlier deadline.
The extension caused applicants to miss a deadline that had already passed.
Officials changed the deadline only after a separate review showed participation had fallen.

exp.trans: 几名申请者错过截止日期后，拨款委员会延长了申请期限。报告说，尚未测量这一调整对后续参与情况的影响。最准确的概括是：错过截止日期促成了延期，但延期对后续参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: extended是主句谓语；after several applicants missed it交代延期的时间背景和触发情境；the effect...has not been measured明确限制了对后续结果的推断。
exp.other: grant committee 拨款委员会；application deadline 申请截止日期；participation 参与；measure 测量、评估。
exp.meaning: 必须区分已知的原因与尚未测量的后果。原文支持错过期限后发生延期，但不支持断言延期一定提高或降低后续参与。
exp.rest: 后续参与数据没有促成前面的延期；延期不可能导致申请者错过一个已经过去的截止日期；原文没有提到另一次审查或参与人数下降。

text4-agreement-target.target: what judges upheld vs legislative justification
text4-agreement-target.skill: 判断题干询问的是司法结论还是解释理由
text4-agreement-target.q: A court upheld municipal inspectors' limited role in checking flood barriers. In support, it cited a law inviting national and municipal teams to share inspection reports. What did the court uphold?
o: National lawmakers were required to lead each municipal inspection.
City inspectors could assist while complying with national rules.
Municipal teams gained the right to replace national flood standards.
National inspectors had to stop exchanging reports with city teams.

exp.trans: 法院认可市政检查员在防洪设施检查中的有限作用，并援引鼓励国家和地方机构共享检查报告的法律作为依据。问题问法院认可的结论，而不是法律提供的支持理由。
exp.structure: A court upheld是第一句核心司法结论；In support, it cited...是第二句介绍支持证据的结构。What did the court uphold要求回到第一句。
exp.other: uphold 维持、认可；municipal 市政的；barrier 防洪设施；cite 引用；inspection 检查；comply with 遵守。
exp.meaning: 法院认可地方机构在法律约束下协助检查；国会的协作规定只是理由。不能把原因中的立法机关错认成法院同意的具体事项。
exp.rest: 立法机关亲自检查不是结论；市政机构没有权力替换国家标准；原文支持共享报告，不能推成停止共享。

text4-agreement-target.target: what the judges agreed on vs why
text4-agreement-target.skill: 题干询问对象 + 结论与理由分层
text4-agreement-target.q: Judges agreed that county officers could verify residency status during certain enforcement encounters. The opinion explains that the national legislature had repeatedly encouraged joint national-local enforcement and information sharing. What did the judges agree on?
o: The national legislature had taken over every local enforcement decision.
Counties were independent of national law.
Local authorities had a legitimate role in enforcement within legal limits.
National officers were required to withhold information.

exp.trans: 法官们同意，县级执法人员在某些执法接触中可以核查居住身份。判决解释说，国家立法机关一直鼓励国家与地方共同执法和共享信息。法官们达成一致的是：地方当局在法律允许的范围内拥有正当的执法角色。
exp.structure: Judges agreed that...直接引出法官认可的结论；The opinion explains that...再引出支持这一结论的理由。不要把后一句的national legislature误当成题干询问的结论主体。
exp.other: verify 核实；enforcement 执法；legitimate 正当的、合法的；withhold information 扣留信息、不提供信息。
exp.meaning: 题干问what did the judges agree on，先找法院允许什么，再看立法机关的政策如何解释该决定。理由提到了国会，不代表答案就是国会介入。
exp.rest: 没有说立法机关接管所有地方执法；地方仍受国家法律约束；原文支持信息共享，而非要求联邦人员隐瞒信息。

text4-agreement-target.skill: 区分司法结论与立法背景
text4-agreement-target.q: A court allows city inspectors to check permit status while coordinating with national officers. The opinion cites a statute encouraging shared databases and joint inspections. Which statement is the court's conclusion rather than the supporting reason?
o: The legislature encouraged coordination between national and local officials.
Local inspectors may play a legitimate role within the enforcement system.
Officials are encouraged to share information.
National law no longer applies to local inspections.

exp.trans: 法院允许城市检查员在与国家执法人员协调时核查许可证状态。判决援引了一项鼓励共享数据库和联合检查的法律。法院的结论是：地方检查员可以在执法体系中发挥正当作用。
exp.structure: The court allows...陈述法院允许的行为；The opinion cites...介绍支撑理由的法律背景。问题要求找conclusion，因此应回到法院实际允许什么。
exp.other: coordinate 协调；permit status 许可证状态；cite 引用；supporting reason 支持理由。
exp.meaning: 文章中的立法背景、理由和司法结论承担不同功能。即使理由出现得更显眼，也不能把它当成题干询问的结论。
exp.rest: 鼓励协调和共享信息都是支持理由；原文并未取消国家法律对地方检查的约束。
